svg.text: Spectrum Paths — six real sources and one honest fallback
FT-710 · FT4222 SPI
scope_pipe subprocess · framed payload
TX pause · close/settle/reopen resync
850-bin wf arrays → ScopeHandler
Real frames emitted only when frame_count advances
Icom / G7250 · CI-V 0x27
Serial or RS-BA1 CI-V tunnel · shared demux
Profile/adopted geometry · bounded newest-data queue
Amplitude scale · upsample 850
USB and network scope support are not assumed identical
SCU-LAN10 · Yaesu network
4096-byte body · boundary marker / 2 → 850 bins
CAT SS; supplies axis · per-port sequence counters
Accept unit data 0x87 as well as 0x07
Serial-only Yaesu: no scope stream → fallback
SunSDR2 DX · native IQ FFT
Exclusive UDP engine · +IF rotation to VFO centre
Device rate → real span · 850-bin adapter
Engine survives last spectrum client for audio/FT8
Whole-model TX verification remains separate
FlexRadio · owned panadapter FFT
Filter stream id and pan ownership · reject foreign packets
16/12/10-byte subheader candidates · strip segment terminators
Radio-read min/max dBm + actual pan start/span · wf1=wf2=FFT
No-slice pan is noise floor, not owned RF · native tile/DAX is future work
SHARED · ScopeHandler + spectrum_profile + 30 Hz scheduler
0x01 + wf1[850] + wf2[850] = 1701 B · short = full[:851] = 851 B · high/mid/low = shape × divider
Legacy /WSspectrum defaults high · /WSterminal adds channel 0x02 only after spectrumCaps · native clients keep version 0x01
S-METER FALLBACK · visual approximation, never fake real bins
RadioState.s_meter → synthetic Gaussian spectrum → same frame variants · byte-identical frames suppressed
A changed S-meter still animates; an unchanged fallback no longer consumes roughly 300 kbps
